notes.title: New Playable Character – Ranger
notes.content:
[p]It's summer! And what better way to enjoy the heat than relaxing with a cool drink and a good game? Some players who tried RP7 at game shows said it’s the perfect game to chill out with a cold beer by their side. We hope you’re all having a refreshing summer![/p][p] [/p][h2]Introducing a New Playable Character – Ranger![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/38208723d65701f6a2fcd586c9aa0c304385265e.gif"][/img][/p][p]The Ranger can’t attack enemies up close, but instead [b]attacks monsters two spaces ahead.[/b] She can only attack if she has arrows, so you’ll need to spin the slots and collect arrows as you go. Arrows are also required to fight bosses, so [b]don’t forget to stock up as you explore![/b][/p][list][*][p]If the Ranger engages a monster in close combat, she takes damage without attacking.[/p][/*][*][p]The Ranger is unlocked by defeating the Demon Lord with the [b]Ninja[/b] character.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3][b]Monster Updates[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/429f86d4e69e48d3038c8c9d13d557705a1d0f07.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Watch out for the tentacles during underwater exploration. They will attack you, but they also hold you in place for one turn, which might actually be useful in some situations.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We’ve added a few more monster combinations to create more varied encounters.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Item Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Ranger-exclusive [b]Quiver[/b] – Arrows now appear in groups of two in slots.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The upgrade tree for the [b]Pedometer[/b] item has been adjusted.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The [b]Lockpicks[/b] item is now upgradeable.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The [b]Roller Skates[/b] item is now upgradeable.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3][b]Skill Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New Ranger-exclusive skills have been added.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Auto Recovery[/b] – now does not activate during monster battles.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes & UI Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where potions wouldn’t appear while the [b]Poison Knife[/b] was equipped.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the [b]Blazing Boots[/b] caused the flame effect to appear abnormally large in certain situations. (Thanks Yew for the Discord report. :D)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the [b]Juggling Balls[/b] item could spin locked slots without being upgraded. (Thanks Yew for the Discord report. :D)[/p][/*][*][p]Added explanatory text for high-tier item chests.[/p][/*][*][p]Added signs that give hints about boss fight mechanics. You no longer have to fear the unknown when facing a boss for the first time![/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3][b]Next Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We’re working on several new NPCs, items, and bosses.[/p][/*][*][p]And stay tuned—two unrevealed playable characters are still on the way![/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3][b]Join the Community[/b][/h3][p]Share your thoughts on our Discord! By joining the [b][url="https://discord.com/invite/Y6jXNJ35AK"]Discord[/url][/b], [b]you can get early access to update builds![/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Contents update: April 2025
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone playing RP7!
This update focuses on skills that help your character grow stronger. We hope it brings you more joy in building up your character.

[h2]New Contents[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/9c29965e50e0d27661f71328a7632da5271883b6.gif[/img]
[b]Graves[/b]
Sometimes you'll find the graves of fallen adventurers in the dungeon. If you like, you can try digging them up. Who knows what you'll find?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/72dd6d6675df4113f46dc6a1c05a84fd6787ed78.gif[/img]
[b]Poison Spike Trap[/b]
A new kind of spike trap has been added. It doesn’t deal damage directly, but the spikes are coated in poison, causing damage over time to your ❤️ for 5 movement turns.

[h2]Chest System Changes[/h2]
After defeating a boss, a skill chest will now always appear. Former boss item chests now appear in the field. They contain high-grade items but cost more than regular item chests.

[h2]New Skills[/h2]

[b]Auto Recovery[/b]
Recovers ❤️ by 1 every time you move. While this skill is equipped, potions will no longer appear in slots.

[b]Bounty Boost[/b]
Monsters drop more gold.

[b]Bonus Shield[/b]
If you spend 200G or more at once, a one-time shield is activated.

[h2]Item Updates[/h2]

[b]Golden Key rework[/b]
Now, when equipped, item chests are opened with keys instead of gold. Spin the slots to collect keys!

[b]Credit Card update[/b]
This item can now be upgraded.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/61fedf495e2db7b82e3cac8b4217071db8f0248c.gif[/img]
[b]Zap Gun added[/b]
When you equip Zap Gun, the gun may now appear in slots. When obtained, it randomly zaps monsters with a jolt of electricity.

[b]Dice[/b] and [b]Anti-Monster[/b] items have been turned into character skills.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

Fixed an issue where you took no damage when fighting a pickpocket.
Fixed several bugs related to playing as the Ninja.
Other minor bug fixes.

[h2]Other[/h2]

Some new level data has been added to create more varied monster combinations in the dungeon.

A new character, [b]Necromancer[/b], was planned but got removed because they weren’t fun.

The development of a new character, [b]Ranger[/b], is almost finished. Look forward to them in the next update!

[h2]Discord[/h2]

Join [url=https://discord.com/invite/Y6jXNJ35AK]RP7 Discord[/url] for early access to updates!

notes.title: Contents Update: Feb. 2025
notes.content:
[h2]1. New Enemies Added[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/dce3e19af16a052b005e9a0614538283c98ae39e.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b] Thief Rabbit[/b]: Thief Rabbits don’t drop gold when attacked. Instead, they steal yours.

[list]
[*] NEW [b]Upgrade Coupon[/b]: Items in chests will now appear at level 2 or higher when you have this coupon.
[*] [b]Stimpack[/b] Adjusted: Increased critical hit chance boost when poisoned.
[*] [b]Blood Shield[/b] Fixed: Fixed a bug where it didn’t work with the "Plague Doctor" character.
[*] [b]Money Bag[/b] Adjusted: When obtained from a chest, it now grants gold equal to the chest's opening cost.
[*] [b]Zombie’s Blood[/b] Adjusted: The item now disappears after activation.
[*] [b]Wooden Sword[/b] Adjusted: Added an upgrade tree.
[*] [b]Atropine[/b] Fixed: Fixed a bug where the item sometimes failed to activate.
[*] [b]Blood Sword[/b] Adjusted: Now restores hearts 100% of the time when landing a critical hit.
[/list]

[h2]3. Other Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
Minor bug fixes and UI improvements.

[h2]4. Next Update Preview[/h2]
A new game mode and new playable character are in development. Stay tuned!

Join [url=https://discord.com/invite/Y6jXNJ35AK]RP7 Discord[/url] for early access to updates!
Happy New Year! 🎉

notes.title: New Playable Character: Bull Knight
notes.content:
[h3][b]1. New Playable Character: Bull Knight[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/622af9cd43b9043aae7add86fa5cb342b188d752.gif[/img]

[b]"A bull only charges forward!"[/b]

The Bull Knight cannot spin slots while moving.
When turning at the edge slots, you gain 7 spins, which accumulate if unused.
Starts with the Gold Shield, which activates only when no armor is equipped.

[b]Tips: The Gold Shield automatically activates when you have no armor, so manage your armor wisely.
Tip: Earning money to ensure the Gold Shield activates in emergencies is key to survival.[/b]

[h3][b]2. New NPC: Priest[/b][/h3]
The Priest, a devotee of Mother Turtle, treats all beings as turtles.
The Priest accepts donations to lift curses from items.

[h3][b]3. New Item: Shadow Blade[/b][/h3]
Your critical chance increases based on the number of cursed items equipped.
It pairs well with the Dark Grimoire.

[h3][b]4. Christmas Update[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/c009faaeddfdac74f922410e808bd1ebed58a679.jpg[/img]
Until December 31, player characters will have Christmas-themed skins!
Meet certain conditions to receive Santa’s Gift: What could you do to ensure Santa leaves a present?

[h3][b]5. Other Updates[/b][/h3]
Various item bugs and interface elements have been fixed.

Wishing you all a joyful holiday season!
Join the discussion on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/Y6jXNJ35AK]RP7 Discord[/url]! Discord users gain early access to updates.

notes.title: Contents Update: Nov. 2024
notes.content:
Are you enjoying RP7?
With the last update, there was a major change to the gameplay style, and we hope it’s made the game even more fun.

---

[b]1. New Items Added[/b]

Equipment: Advanced Skillbook
- If you have this book, a skill chest will appear instead of an item chest after a boss fight.

Equipment: Balance Stick
- Increases critical hit chance when hearts and armor are equal.

Equipment: Sword of Growth
- Each time you open a chest, critical hit rate increases, and each time you skip opening one, critical hit rate decreases.

Equipment: Club T-shirt
- Increases the chance of shields appearing when spinning multiple slots simultaneously.

Equipment: Radar
- Lowers the appearance rate of monsters in the slot being spun.

Equipment: Dark Grimoire
- When you have this book, a cursed chest will appear instead of an item chest.

Skill: Random Blessing
- Swaps the max values of hearts and armor.

[b]2. Boss Fight Improvements[/b]
We’ve adjusted the difficulty for the Griffin and Plague Doctor bosses, as they received feedback about being too challenging. Now, the damage of each boss varies based on the stage they appear in.

[b]3. Object Appearance Rate Improvements[/b]
Some probability tweaks have been added in-game. Hopefully, you’ll find yourself thinking, “Why does the same thing keep appearing?!” a little less often.

[b]4. Other[/b]
Kickstarter backers who requested name changes have had their supporter names updated!
Various bug fixes, error corrections, and UI improvements.

---

Moving forward, new content updates are expected about once every 1–2 months during the early access period, with intermittent updates focused on bug fixes and gameplay improvements in between.

Join us on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/Y6jXNJ35AK]RP7 Discord[/url] to share your thoughts!

notes.title: Update 241026
notes.content:
RP7 has had a small but significant change.

While the gameplay that challenges both physical and brainy skill is fun, we’ve noticed many players find it a bit tiring. Originally, we were planning to add the new ‘Bull Knight’ character to allow for a more relaxed playstyle. However, we decided it would be better to make this change a fundamental feature of the player character's behavior.

[b]Now, when the character reaches the slot at either end and changes direction, they will stop moving. After this, you’ll have the opportunity to spin any three slots of your choice, and once that’s done, the character will start moving again.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/cdc3d3abeb17dc0d01274cbbf09e0177ba4701e1.gif[/img]

This new feature allows players to take a breather, making it easier to assess the current game situation and plan more strategically. We hope this update makes the game easier and even more enjoyable.


[Other Updates]

[list] [*] Adjusted difficulty for certain bosses and stages. [*] Fixed some text and texture size errors. [/list]

notes.title: Steam trading card launched!
notes.content:
RP7 Trading Cards are now available on Steam!
Enjoy playing the game and collect trading cards to unlock special badges, emoticons, and other items.

notes.title: Update 241014
notes.content:
[b]Game Data Save[/b]
The data-saving feature has been improved. Now, game data will be saved when you reach game over & village, start each stage, and visit the shop after defeating a boss.

[b]Rainbow Slime Boss Adjustment[/b]
The Rainbow Slime Boss’s base damage has been increased, but the spins required to lower its damage have been reduced a lot. The boss is now stronger, but you can weaken it more quickly.

[b]Interface Improvements[/b]
To improve understanding, the game will now temporarily pause when signs appear at certain points. Additionally, various interface elements that interfered with gameplay have been adjusted.

[b]Sacrifice Rewards Added[/b]

[img]https://presskit.turtle-cream.com/games/rp7/images/reward.gif[/img]
After defeating a boss, you can make sacrifices to receive rewards. Each item has a specific reward, so plan your sacrifices strategically!

[b]Halloween Update: Pumpkin Potion[/b]

[img]https://presskit.turtle-cream.com/games/rp7/images/pumpkin.gif[/img]
Until November 1st (GMT), Pumpkin Potions will appear in slots. Drinking a Pumpkin Potion causes ❤️ damage but restores 🔷 by 2. Player titles and Steam achievements related to the Pumpkin Potion have been added—enjoy Halloween!

notes.title: Update 240924
notes.content:
[b]Added Exit Menu: [/b]
We have added the exit menu to areas where it was previously missing, such as in the village and character selection.

[b]Level Design Adjustment: [/b]
We have adjusted the appearance probability of some objects in certain levels.

[b]Sound Bug Fix: [/b]
Fixed an issue where sound volume could not be adjusted in certain situations.

[b]Game data save:[/b]
he game data is now saved at the village point. 
We are currently working on saving the data related to stage progress.

notes.title: Update 240920
notes.content:
1. Dice Upgrade:
We have reduced the overpowering effect of the dice and made it upgradeable.

2. Stimpack Upgrade:
You can now upgrade the Stimpack to make its effects stronger.

3. Cheese Updated:
Cheese no longer replaces potions and shields. Instead, you can upgrade it to enhance its effect.

4. Campfire Added to the Village:
You can change your character at the campfire.
When changing the character in the village, gold is carried over, but items are not.

[img]https://presskit.turtle-cream.com/games/rp7/images/campfire.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 240918
notes.content:
[b][Content Changes][/b]

1. Cat's Paw Upgrade Tree Added:
You can now upgrade the Cat's Paw to gradually increase the critical hit chance against rat-type monsters.

2. Glue Upgrade Tree Added:
The very powerful effect of Glue has been nerfed, but it can now be upgraded.

3. Carousel Upgrade Tree Added:
By upgrading the Carousel, shields and potions will start appearing on the Carousel.

4. Rapier Upgrade Tree Added:
You can now upgrade the Rapier to increase the critical hit rate with consecutive battles against the same monster.

5. Stopwatch Upgrade Tree Adjusted:
The Stopwatch can be upgraded to increase item activation time and adjust the conditions for item activation.

6. Ruby Upgrade Tree Adjusted:
Upgrading the Ruby increases the damage it takes, but reduces damage from other monsters.

7. Toy Hammer Upgrade Tree Adjusted:
Through upgrades, you can increase the item activation chance or reduce monster damage with the Toy Hammer.

8. Game Speed Adjustment Menu Added:
You can now adjust the game speed in the pause menu by pressing ESC.

Other improvements include UI enhancements, and we’ve fixed bugs that were causing sudden game crashes.

notes.title: Update 240917
notes.content:
Thank you for playing RP7!
Please check out the following updates:

[b][Contents Update][/b]

Potion Bag Typo Fixed:
When the potion bag activates, it spawns a potion in a random position. The previous description incorrectly stated that "the stocked potion is used automatically." This has been corrected.

Cheese Upgrade:
Cheese can now be upgraded! At the final upgrade, it becomes even more effective.

Invisible Cloak Upgrade:
By upgrading the cloak, you can now avoid poison bottles as well.

Neutralizer Upgrade:
The overly powerful effect has been nerfed, but the Neutralizer is now upgradable.

[b][Next Minor Update][/b]

We've received a lot of feedback regarding game data saving. While it’s difficult to save the game in real time with every movement, we’re planning to save the data at least at the beginning of each stage.

Campfire in the Village:
A campfire is coming to the village! You will be able to change your player character here.

We're continuing to make non-upgradable items upgradable.

After 7 years of conceptualization and development, RP7: Spin Your Own Encounter has finally opened its early access mode today!

notes.content:
Hello, players!

Developed by Turtle Cream and published by IndieArk, 'RP7' just launched its [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rp7/rp7]Kickstarter[/url] campaign today. Check it out to get various exquisite merch:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rp7/rp7][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/ebb4897aa92d077c4cdfe7d828443cb31c4a4a45.png[/img][/url]

This campaign offers you the chance to buy the game at a lower price and get some amazing merch.

Includes adorable[b] character stickers[/b], [b]exclusive posters[/b], and specially made[b]collectible metal cards[/b]!
More importantly, our [b]custom controller[/b], which we designed ourselves, is also part of the crowdfunding rewards!

This special console has received rave reviews from players at offline exhibitions, so we decided to collaborate with a handmade manufacturer to bring this unique experience to fans of 'RP7'! You can decorate it with our stickers and create your own personalized console, making it a valuable collectible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/25a18ddab6cd392f6d3b13a66459a1546fe663b1.png[/img]

There are also limited custom tiers where your unique design can appear on NPC faces!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37871589/6702c03a2f0f0c2dad95b36c517e29ed7054c765.png[/img]

Here are all the crowdfunding rewards:
[list]
[*] STEAM KEY for the game (cheaper Early Bird tier limited to 77 copies!)
[*] Digital Soundtrack
[*] Poster & Sticker
[*] Card set
[*] Custom-made controller
[*] Your portrait as NPC in the game (limited to two)
[*] Your portrait as merchant in the game (tutorial, NPC, Playable) (limited to one)
[/list]

'RP7' is a unique and innovative "slot management" RPG. Players cannot directly control the character; they only need to refresh the slots continuously to determine the character's adventure. There are 7 slots in the game, which will randomly refresh monsters, items, coins, and more. By strategically refreshing the items, players can acquire equipment and experience to strengthen the character's abilities, continuously venture forth, and face BOSS challenges!

Keep resetting the 7 slots and embark on the adventure to find your missing pet frog! Experience endless RPG fun with simple mechanics!

The game is nearing completion, and we welcome everyone to try our DEMO. If you like it, don't forget to add it to your wishlist!

notes.title: This weird roguelike is about working a slot machine
notes.content:
When you hear the word "roguelike," certain things leap to mind: procedural dungeons maybe, and randomized upgrades and loot. RP7 throws most of that playbook out the window: it's a game about a knight who moves back and forth across a set of slots, and your only way to control what happens is to spin the slots and hope something better turns up each time.

Read the rest of the story...
